title: Compose witnessed potential impact with traversal limits
statement: The Views and traceability Module shall compose relationship-based potential impact from an exact changed-subject and influence selection, retaining a supporting typed witness for every candidate and preserving traversal limitations without asserting actual consequences.

what.problem: Derived responsibility or impact results can hide missing scope and be mistaken for stronger engineering conclusions.
what.desired_outcome: Compose witnessed potential impact with traversal limits.

why.rationale: SR-011 requires an accountable result owner preserving its exact finding and completeness semantics.

conditions: A participant requests the corresponding analysis in one selected model state.

contexts: MOD-004 logical analysis boundary using IF-001/IF-002 and its internal traversal contribution.

how.approach: Bind explicit request and source identities, derive attributable results, preserve unknown or limited scope, and leave stronger judgments with their owners.

how_much.scope: The MOD-004 result obligation for all five SR-011 criteria; content custody, profile interpretation and general traversal retain existing owners and ARs.

acceptance_criteria: For every reported non-seed candidate, retain an identified changed subject and at least one finite typed path with original and traversal orientation, intermediate identities, provenance and exact selected-state basis.

Apply the selected relationship-type and orientation pairs at every step of one combined influence graph; reject supplied traversal support with mismatched state, profile, inventory, changed subjects, influence or limits rather than broaden or reinterpret it.

Keep changed subjects separate from impact candidates and report no additional relationship-based impact only after complete exploration, explicitly limited to the selected influence scope without denying unrecorded or real-world effects.

Carry explicit depth/count bounds and omitted frontier, incomplete acquisition/interpretation/traversal or witness composition, interruption and resource exhaustion into the result; missing/ambiguous starts and empty partial results cannot become complete no-impact.

Label every candidate as potential impact for engineering review; reached implementation or evidence does not by itself establish behavior change, invalidation, required action, permission or satisfaction.
constraints: Proposed architecture only; no runtime availability, implementation or verification claim.

sources.basis: Derive rule-bound allocation assessment and scope-bound potential-impact result contracts with distinct MOD-004 obligations. Reuse content, interpretation and traversal ownership; proposed Design only.
